title: Triterpenes isolated from Cleome amblyocarpa: evaluation of antioxidant potential

Investigation of the chemical constituents of Cleome amblyocarpa growing wild in Jordan resulted in the isolation and structural elucidation of two new dammarane triterpenes along with 9 other known compounds.
